exercises.paragraph: For the following exercises, use implicit differentiation to find $$\frac{dy}{dx}.$$

solution.paragraph: $$d y d x = -2 x y d y d x = -2 x y$$
$$d y d x = x 3 y - y 2 x d y d x = x 3 y - y 2 x$$
$$d y d x = y - y 2 x + 4 x + 4 - x d y d x = y - y 2 x + 4 x + 4 - x$$
$$d y d x = y 2 cos ( x y ) 2 y - sin ( x y ) - x y cos ( x y ) d y d x = y 2 cos ( x y ) 2 y - sin ( x y ) - x y cos ( x y )$$

exercises.paragraph: For the following exercises, find an equation of the tangent line to the graph of the given equation at the indicated point. Use a calculator or computer software to graph the function and the tangent line.

problem.paragraph: [T] The graph of a folium of Descartes with equation $$2x^{3} + 2y^{3} - 9xy = 0$$ is given in the following graph.

list.item: Find an equation of the tangent line at the point $$\left( {2,1} \right).$$ Graph the tangent line along with the folium.
Find an equation of the normal line to the tangent line in a. at the point $$\left( {2,1} \right).$$
Find an equation of the normal to the tangent line at the point $$\left( {1,1} \right).$$
At what other point does the normal line in a. intersect the graph of the equation?

problem.paragraph: Find all points on the graph of $$y^{3} - 27y = x^{2} - 90$$ at which the tangent line is vertical.

list.item: Find the slope of the tangent line(s) at the x-intercept(s).
What does the value(s) in b. indicate about the tangent line(s)?

solution.paragraph: a. $$(\pm 7,0)(\pm 7,0)$$ b. $$-2-2$$ c. They are parallel since the slope is the same at both intercepts.

problem.paragraph: Find an equation of the tangent line to the graph of the equation $$\sin^{-1}x + \sin^{-1}y = \frac{\pi}{6}$$ at the point $$\left( {0,\frac{1}{2}} \right).$$
Find an equation of the tangent line to the graph of the equation $$\tan^{-1}\left( {x + y} \right) = x^{2} + \frac{\pi}{4}$$ at the point $$\left( {0,1} \right).$$

[T] The number of cell phones produced when $$x$$ dollars is spent on labor and $$y$$ dollars is spent on capital invested by a manufacturer can be modeled by the equation $$60x^{3/4}y^{1/4} = 3240.$$

list.item: Find $$\frac{dy}{dx}$$ and evaluate at the point $$\left( {81,16} \right).$$

solution.paragraph: a. $$-0.5926-0.5926$$ b. When \$81 is spent on labor and \$16 is spent on capital, the amount spent on capital is decreasing by \$0.5926 per \$1 spent on labor.

problem.paragraph: [T] The number of cars produced when $$x$$ dollars is spent on labor and $$y$$ dollars is spent on capital invested by a manufacturer can be modeled by the equation $$30x^{1/3}y^{2/3} = 360.$$
(Both $$x$$ and $$y$$ are measured in thousands of dollars.)

list.item: Find $$\frac{dy}{dx}$$ and evaluate at the point $$\left( {27,8} \right).$$

problem.paragraph: The volume of a right circular cone of radius $$x$$ and height $$y$$ is given by $$V = \frac{1}{3}\pi x^{2}y.$$ Suppose that the volume of the cone is a constant. Find $$\frac{dy}{dx}$$ when $$x = 4$$ and $$y = 16.$$

exercises.paragraph: For the following exercises, consider a closed rectangular box with a square base with side $$x$$ and height $$y.$$

problem.paragraph: Find an equation for the surface area of the rectangular box, $$S\left( {x,y} \right).$$
If the surface area of the rectangular box is 78 square feet, find $$\frac{dy}{dx}$$ when $$x = 3$$ feet and $$y = 5$$ feet.
